=={{header|Ada}}==
The solution below relies on `Rasters`, a work-in-progress custom package not listed here.
It generates many frames and outputs them in PPM format.
From there one can use several tools to generate the following image
(and they could be generated from the program as well by invoking those system commands).

[[File:Anim.gif|thumb|center|alt=vibrating rectangles|Result of the Ada solution to the Vibrating Rectangles task]]

<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">
--  modern Ada
pragma Ada_2022;
--  extra-modern Ada ;-)
pragma Extensions_Allowed (On);

--  imports
with Rasters;

procedure Vibrating_Rectangles is

   Dimension : constant Positive := 256;
   --  canvas size
   Step      : constant Positive := Integer'Max (1, 256 / (Dimension / 2));
   --  amount to step the color each frame

   package R is new Rasters.RGB_Raster
     (Width => Dimension, Height => Dimension);
   --  initialize a new raster handling package with the desired dimension
   Raster : R.Raster;
   --  the raster itself
   --  we'll write onto one canvas, since that will suffice

begin
   --  first clear it
   Raster.Choose_Pen (R.Colors.White);
   Raster.Clear;
   --  now draw onto it
   --  we will fade blue boxes in (1 * Dimension),
   --  then fade them out (1 * Dimension), giving 2 * Dimension
   for Ith in 1 .. 2 * Dimension loop
      if Ith <= Dimension then   --  fade in
         --  Jth mod 2 = 0 draws every other rectangle
         for Jth in 1 .. Natural'Min (Ith, Dimension / 2) when Jth mod 2 = 0
         loop
            --  this mildly complicated formula fades from outermost rectangle in
            Raster.Choose_Pen
              ((Red | Green => Integer'Max (0, 255 - (Ith - Jth + 1) * Step),
                others => 255));
            Raster.Move_To ((Col => Jth, Row => Jth));
            Raster.Draw_Rectangle_To
              ((Col => Dimension - Jth + 1, Row => Dimension - Jth + 1));
         end loop;
      else  --  fade out
         for Jth in
           1 .. Natural'Min (Ith - Dimension, Dimension / 2) when Jth mod 2 = 0
         loop
            Raster.Choose_Pen
              ((Red | Green =>
                  Integer'Min (255, ((Ith - Dimension) - Jth + 1) * Step),
                others => 255));
            Raster.Move_To ((Col => Jth, Row => Jth));
            Raster.Draw_Rectangle_To
              ((Col => Dimension - Jth + 1, Row => Dimension - Jth + 1));
         end loop;
      end if;
      --  save individual frames to combine into an animation
      declare
         Suffix    : String          := "_0000";
         --  appended to output filenames
         To_Suffix : constant String := Ith'Image;
         --  Ada's 'Image attribute sticks a space before positive numbers alas
         --  that requires us to handle the suffixes a little delicately
      begin
         for Jth in reverse 1 .. To_Suffix'Length loop
            if To_Suffix (Jth) /= ' ' then
               Suffix (Suffix'Length - (To_Suffix'Length - Jth)) :=
                 To_Suffix (Jth);
            end if;
         end loop;
         Raster.Save ("frame" & Suffix & ".ppm", R.PPM);
      end;
   end loop;
end Vibrating_Rectangles;
</syntaxhighlight>
The solution based on [[GTK]]. It creates a layered widget holding rectangles. On each periodic redraw the opacity of the lines are modified.
{{libheader|AICWL}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="Ada">
with Cairo;                        use Cairo;
with Cairo.Ellipses;               use Cairo.Ellipses;
with Gdk.Color;                    use Gdk.Color;
with GLib;                         use GLib;
with Gtk.Layered;                  use Gtk.Layered;
with Gtk.Layered.Line;             use Gtk.Layered.Line;
with Gtk.Layered.Refresh_Engine;   use Gtk.Layered.Refresh_Engine;
with Gtk.Missed;                   use Gtk.Missed;
with Gtk.Window;                   use Gtk.Window;
with Gtk.Widget;                   use Gtk.Widget;

with GLib.Object.Checked_Destroy;
with Gtk.Main;

procedure Fading_Rectangles is

   type Refresher is new Layered_Refresh_Engine with null record;
   overriding
      procedure Refresh (Engine : in out Refresher);

   Window  : Gtk_Window;
   Size    : constant := 130;
   Color   : constant Gdk_Color := RGB (0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
   Engine  : Refresher;

   type Rectangle is array (1..4) of access Line_Layer;
   function Create
            (  Widget    : Gtk_Layered;
               Center    : Cairo_Tuple;
               Half_Size : GDouble
            )  return Rectangle is
   begin
      return
      (  Add_Line
         (  Under => Widget,
            From  => (Center.X - Half_Size, Center.Y - Half_Size),
            To    => (Center.X - Half_Size, Center.Y + Half_Size),
            Color => Color
         ),
         Add_Line
         (  Under => Widget,
            From  => (Center.X + Half_Size, Center.Y - Half_Size),
            To    => (Center.X + Half_Size, Center.Y + Half_Size),
            Color => Color
         ),
         Add_Line
         (  Under => Widget,
            From  => (Center.X - Half_Size, Center.Y - Half_Size),
            To    => (Center.X + Half_Size, Center.Y - Half_Size),
            Color => Color
         ),
         Add_Line
         (  Under => Widget,
            From  => (Center.X - Half_Size, Center.Y + Half_Size),
            To    => (Center.X + Half_Size, Center.Y + Half_Size),
            Color => Color
      )  );
   end Create;

   type Rectangle_No is mod 20;
   type Vibration    is mod 10;
   List    : array (Rectangle_No) of Rectangle;
   Current : Rectangle_No := 0;
   Opacity : Vibration    := Vibration'Last;

   function Create return Gtk_Widget is
      Widget  : Gtk_Layered;
      Center  : constant Cairo_Tuple :=
                         (GDouble (Size / 2), GDouble (Size / 2));
   begin
      Gtk_New (Widget);
      for Index in List'Range loop
         List (Index) :=
            Create (Widget, Center, 3.0 * GDouble (Index - 1) + 1.0);
      end loop;
      Engine.Add (Widget);
      return Widget.all'Unchecked_Access;
   end Create;

   procedure Refresh (Engine : in out Refresher) is
   begin
      Current := Current - 1;
      declare
         This : Rectangle renames List (Current);
      begin
         for Index in This'Range loop
            declare
               Line : Line_Layer renames This (Index).all;
            begin
               Line.Set
               (  From    => Line.Get_From,
                  To      => Line.Get_To,
                  Line    => Line.Get_Line,
                  Opacity => GDouble (Opacity) / GDouble (Vibration'Last)
               );
            end;
         end loop;
         if Current = 0 then
            Opacity := Opacity - 1;
         end if;
      end;
      Layered_Refresh_Engine (Engine).Refresh;
   end Refresh;

begin
   Gtk.Main.Init;
   Gtk.Window.Gtk_New (Window);
   Window.Set_Title ("Fading");
   Window.On_Delete_Event (Gtk.Missed.Delete_Event_Handler'Access);
   Window.On_Destroy (Gtk.Missed.Destroy_Handler'Access);
   Window.Set_Size_Request (Size, Size);
   Window.Add (Create);
   Set_Period (Engine, 0.02);
   Window.Show_All;
   Gtk.Main.Main;
end Fading_Rectangles;
</syntaxhighlight>

A solution based on [https://github.com/jrcarter/Ada_GUI Ada GUI]. This implements the task pointed to by the "Create [https://1drv.ms/v/s!AqDUIunCqVnIg1MxKPi5DzwUbJEf Vibrating rectangles]" part of the task description.

<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">
-- The Vibrating Rectangles Rosetta Code task
-- J. Carter    2026 Jul
-- This implements the version pointed to by the "Create" link in the task statement
-- Uses Ada_GUI (https://github.com/jrcarter/Ada_GUI)

with Ada.Real_Time;
with Ada_GUI;

procedure Vibrating_Rectangles is
   protected Signalling is
      procedure Start;
      -- Releases Wait_For_Start

      procedure Stop;
      -- Releases Wait_For_Stop

      entry Wait_For_Start;
      -- Waits until Start is called

      entry Wait_For_Stop;
      -- Waits until Stop is called
   private -- Signalling
      Running : Boolean := False;
   end Signalling;

   task Artist;
   -- Draws the rectangles

   protected body Signalling is
      procedure Start is
         -- Empty
      begin -- Start
         Running := True;
      end Start;

      procedure Stop is
         -- Empty
      begin -- Stop
         Running := False;
      end Stop;

      entry Wait_For_Start when Running is
         -- Empty
      begin -- Wait_For_Start
         null;
      end Wait_For_Start;

      entry Wait_For_Stop when not Running is
         -- Empty
      begin -- Wait_For_Stop
         null;
      end Wait_For_Stop;
   end Signalling;

   Display : Ada_GUI.Widget_ID;

   task body Artist is
      Max_Size : constant := 45;
      Min_Size : constant :=  3;

      Interval : constant Ada.Real_Time.Time_Span := Ada.Real_Time.To_Time_Span (0.5);

      type Color_Number is mod 3;

      type Color_Map is array (Color_Number) of Ada_GUI.Color_Info;

      Map : constant Color_Map := (0 => (Red => 255, Green =>   0, Blue =>   0, Alpha => 1.0),
                                   1 => (Red =>   0, Green => 255, Blue =>   0, Alpha => 1.0),
                                   2 => (Red =>   0, Green =>   0, Blue => 255, Alpha => 1.0) );

      Center :  Natural; -- Constant after intialization

      Next  : Ada.Real_Time.Time := Ada.Real_Time.Clock;
      Size  : Integer;
      Color : Color_Number := 0;

      use type Ada.Real_Time.Time;
   begin -- Artist
      Signalling.Wait_For_Start;
      Center := Display.Width / 2;

      Forever : loop
         All_Colors : loop
            Size := Max_Size;

            All_Rectangles : loop
               exit All_Rectangles when Size < Min_Size;

               Display.Draw_Rectangle (From_X     => Center - Size,
                                       From_Y     => Center - Size,
                                       To_X       => Center + Size,
                                       To_Y       => Center + Size,
                                       Line_Color => (None => False, Color => Map (Color) ) );
               Next := Next + Interval;
               Size := Size - Min_Size;

               select
                  Signalling.Wait_For_Stop;

                  exit Forever;
               or
                  delay until Next;
               end select;
            end loop All_Rectangles;

            Color := Color + 1;
         end loop All_Colors;
      end loop Forever;
   end Artist;

   Event : Ada_GUI.Next_Result_Info;

   use type Ada_GUI.Event_Kind_ID;
begin -- Vibrating_Rectangles
   Ada_GUI.Set_Up (Title => "Vibrating Rectangles");
   Display := Ada_GUI.New_Graphic_Area (Width => 100, Height => 100);
   Signalling.Start;

   Wait_For_End : loop
      Event := Ada_GUI.Next_Event;

      exit Wait_For_End when not Event.Timed_Out and then Event.Event.Kind = Ada_GUI.Window_Closed;
   end loop Wait_For_End;

   Signalling.Stop;

   delay 1.0;

   Ada_GUI.End_GUI;
end Vibrating_Rectangles;
</syntaxhighlight>
